output.subject: Your call about the ATM at our Old Post Rd branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us about the ATM at our Old Post Rd branch. You told us that the machine's screen is cracked and that it has been out of service for more than two weeks. We understand how inconvenient it is when a machine you rely on isn't available, especially for that length of time, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

You mentioned that you didn't have a problem with any transaction, and that your main concern is getting the ATM back in working order. We have passed on your feedback, including your request for the machine to be repaired, to our Branch & Contact Center team, who will review it. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for taking the time to let us know. Hearing from customers like you helps us understand what people experience when they visit our branches.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm the current status of the Old Post Rd branch ATM and whether a repair date can be shared.
The call note says a ticket was raised with the ATM vendor. Decide whether to mention this to the customer, as the draft leaves it out.
Consider whether to point the customer to nearby ATMs or other ways to access cash while this machine is out of service.
Check whether other customers have reported the same ATM outage, since the customer says it has lasted 2+ weeks.
The call note says there was no transaction issue. Confirm with the customer if anything suggests otherwise.
